title: From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Imitation learning policies are intended to make robotic manipulation robust to variations in object pose, appearance, and environment that challenge pre-programmed motion. However, real-world performance remains difficult to predict, as conventional optimization signals such as validation loss show no consistent relationship with robot success. To identify the design choices that govern real-world performance, 281 imitation-learning policies spanning seven policy families were evaluated in approximately 1,700 real-robot trials of RJ45 connector grasping and insertion using a five-fingered robotic hand. Controlled ablations showed that observation and action representations dominated conventional optimizer and sampling choices. For point-cloud policies, region-of-interest cropping, representation in the robot-base frame, and normalization within the point encoder each improved success by 70-100 percentage points. translated_title: 从遥操作到长时程灵巧性：评估灵巧操作的视觉运动技能与离线代理指标
translated_abstract: 模仿学习策略旨在使机器人操作对物体姿态、外观和环境的变化具有鲁棒性，而这些变化正是预编程运动所难以应对的。然而，真实世界的性能仍然难以预测，因为诸如验证损失等传统优化信号与机器人任务成功率之间并未表现出一致的关系。为了找出决定真实世界性能的设计选择，研究者使用五指机器人手，在约1,700次真实机器人实验中评估了涵盖七个策略族的281个模仿学习策略，任务为RJ45连接器的抓取与插入。受控消融实验表明，观测和动作表示的影响超过了传统的优化器与采样选择。对于点云策略，感兴趣区域裁剪、在机器人基座坐标系中的表示以及点编码器内的归一化，每一项均可将成功率提高70-100个百分点。对于视觉-语言（策略，摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过约1,700次真实机器人实验，系统评估了281个模仿学习策略在五指灵巧手RJ45连接器抓取与插入任务中的表现，发现观测与动作表示的设计选择（如感兴趣区域裁剪、基座坐标系表示和点编码器归一化）对真实世界成功率的影响远超优化器和采样等传统选择，单项改进即可带来70-100个百分点的成功率提升。
en_tdlr: Evaluating 281 imitation-learning policies across ~1,700 real-robot trials of five-fingered RJ45 connector grasping and insertion, this work shows that observation and action representation choices (ROI cropping, robot-base-frame representation, and point-encoder normalization) dominate real-world success over conventional optimizer and sampling choices, each improving success by 70-100 percentage points.
